title: Consistent Order Selection under Non-Identifiability and Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2609.23220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We provide sufficient conditions for the consistency of penalized least squares procedures that select the order (dimension) of a regression model from a sequence of nested classes, allowing for dependent, martingale-difference errors. The main contribution is to relax the classical identifiability requirement: parameters indexing classes larger than the true order need not be identified, provided the additional, excess directions admit a linear approximation to the truth in a neighbourhood of the true parameter. This relaxation lets the number of candidate models grow with the sample size, removing the usual need for a fixed upper bound. We verify the resulting high-level conditions for two classes of nonlinear regression models used in applied work: multiple-regime smooth transition regression and mixture-of-experts models with generic generalized linear model experts. translated_title: 非可识别性与依赖性下的一致阶数选择
translated_abstract: 我们为惩罚最小二乘程序的一致性提供了充分条件，该程序从一系列嵌套类中选择回归模型的阶数（维度），并允许存在相关的鞅差误差。主要贡献在于放宽了经典的可识别性要求：索引大于真实阶数的类所对应的参数无需被识别，只要额外的冗余方向在真实参数的邻域内容许对真值的线性近似即可。这一放宽使得候选模型的数量可以随样本量增长，摆脱了通常需要固定上界的限制。我们针对应用研究中使用的两类非线性回归模型验证了所得的高层条件：多区制平滑转移回归以及具有一般广义线性模型专家的专家混合模型。在BIC型惩罚下，所得的阶数选择规则是一致的。
tldr: 该论文放宽了惩罚最小二乘阶数选择中的经典可识别性假设，允许候选模型数量随样本量增长，并将一致性结果验证于多区制平滑转移回归和专家混合模型两类非线性回归模型。
en_tdlr: This paper relaxes the classical identifiability requirement for consistent order selection via penalized least squares, allowing the number of candidate models to grow with the sample size, and verifies the conditions for multiple-regime smooth transition regression and mixture-of-experts models.
